description: What `bun run unity:new-project` carries from a finished GSPro course project into a fresh one (GSPro base project unzipped, OPCD folder beside it). Paths are relative to the project's Assets folder unless noted. packages: copied whole, missing and newer files only. projectFolders: the same, relative to the project root. skip: never copied (globs; course-specific or unused). defines: scripting define symbols the packages need (Standalone). coursePresets: files in the source course folder that seed the new course folder, with the source course name in asset paths rewritten.
